about.title: About me
about.description: Hello! I'm Irene Alcaine, a graduate in Engineering and Junior programmer. After obtaining my degree, I discovered that my true passion is development, especially web development. I enjoy beautiful and original designs, and whenever I can, I take some time to develop my ideas and personal projects.
about.experience-description: Recently, I have been able to dedicate myself professionally to programming, and I couldn't be happier, without neglecting the years of experience developing my soft skills in other jobs, such as customer service, teamwork, stress management, and time management.
about.education-description: Since early 2022, I have been satisfying my curiosity and learning on my own. Additionally, I have completed some frontend and web publishing courses. I have never stopped learning new technologies and improving my skills in web development.
